name: Plague Mouth
body:
School necromancy [disease, evil]; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 4, death mage 4, druid 4, lathspell 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You turn into a plague-bearing monster. You gain a 1d6 bite attack that can be used as a primary natural attack or as a secondary with other attacks. On a successful hit with the bite, the target must make a Fortitude save or be inflicted with bubonic plague. Alternatively, if you are currently afflicted, or carrying, a disease, you may instead transmit that disease using this spell’s Fortitude save DC in place of the disease’s DC.
